items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Then Mud Carter, he come with us for a while. Then he left, went back, and he come back and played with Jack.

ctx.x: He said who was Crowback? Crowback was a saxophone player. For about seven years, he looked something like a white boy, you know? What was his last name? What was his last name? Crowback? That's his last name, Crowback. I forget his first name. I forget his first name. How many things? Huh? Yeah. He said he forget his first name. Who did he play with? He had much to carry with us a lot. Who did he play with? Crowback. Crowback. He was playing with us. We had, you know, this is making up a band. Sometimes we were…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He picked up me, Chester, Charlie... It was Chester and Charlie and me when you first come in the band.

ctx.x: Not Mud Carey. Yeah, Mud Carey, not Mud Carter, Mud Carey. Do you remember Jack Terry, Bjornie? I know him, yeah. Yeah, that's what I said. He was playing with him, Bjornie then.
Well, Mud Carter and Mud Carey are two different guys. Yeah, I know both of them.
